svg.title: House technique or standard
svg.desc: Models citing each paper against distinct publishers citing it.
svg.text: Each of 418 papers by how many models cite it and how many distinct publishers do. Log x.
332 of 418 papers (79%) are cited by exactly one publisher — their own author. A ranking by model count alone hides that entirely.
Excluded: 1910.09700 on 13 publishers — the carbon-emissions field of the model-card template, and it would set the y-scale on its own.
